author: GamingBolt
description:
After months, maybe even years of anticipation, Rockstar Games finally did it. No, not release Grand Theft Auto 6 (that's still about 34 days away), or announce the PC version, which has recently been rumored. And no, this isn't quite the coveted Trailer 3 either, but it is a new trailer for its massive open-world sequel/next masterpiece. 1.5 years after the last. Reset the clock.

Of course, online discourse already criticized it as “weak,” despite it being a launch trailer (and more than likely used for TV spots, given the prominence of PS5 advertising at the start and end), it still offered a wealth of new details.
title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Analyzed - What The Hell Is Going On?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (2026) sees the game purportedly returning to the genre’s roots while also introducing some significant changes to the Call of Duty formula. From multiplayer changes, to DMZ growing into a core mode and foundational changes to how progression works, there’s plenty that distinguishes 2026’s MW4 from 2023’s Modern Warfare 3. 

Whether you buy first person shooters every year or are considering jumping into the genre for the first time in a while, here are fifteen of the biggest differences between Modern Warfare 4 (2026) and its predecessor.
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 (2026) vs Modern Warfare 3 (2023): 15 BIGGEST Differences

Thanks to Keen Games for sponsoring this video.

Check out Enshrouded 1.0: https://connect.enshrouded.com/GamingBolt

Keen Games has always been ambitious. The German outfit launched Enshrouded to early access in January 2024, and even that early build showed promising foundations. Enshrouded is developed and published by Keen Games, who also happens to be this video's sponsor. You can find a link to the game’s page in the description below, so if it sounds up your alley, feel free to give it a try. They were kind enough to give us access, so huge thanks to them for the opportunity.

So, what is Enshrouded 1.0? It features a gorgeous world, with swift traversal mechanics, NPC-specific crafting, and a suite of light survival mechanics that led the game to find an audience. Despite some rough edges, the studio’s vision for what an immersive survival ARPG title should be was clear, and the direction they’ve taken the game since the early access launch is nothing short of impressive.
